name: Lord Of Mysteries
overview: City of Silver  Overview: Focuses heavily on the Forsaken Land of God and the sunless, cursed bastion known as the City of Silver. It introduces the tragic history of the area and showcases Derrick Berg ("The Sun") praying to The Fool above the gray fog, seeking salvation for his people. The Marked Hunt (Part 1 & 2)  Overview: This two-part special shifts focus to Backlund and the maritime plotlines. It follows Alger Wilson ("The Hanged Man") proposing a high-stakes exchange to hunt down Qilangos, one of the infamous seven Pirate Admirals. It highlights Audrey Hall ("Justice") utilizing her noble influence to track the wind-blessed killer while showcasing the terrifying reality of Creeping Hunger.
